# AI Security Matrix (ASM) — aisecmatrix.com

> AI Security Matrix (ASM, AISecMatrix) provides AI security testing and LLM penetration testing — prompt injection, AI agent and RAG security, AI red teaming — plus web, API, mobile and cloud penetration testing, and free browser-based security tools.

## Services
- [AI & LLM security testing services](https://aisecmatrix.com/services.html): AI/LLM, red teaming, application, cloud, GRC and advisory services
- [Contact / request an assessment](https://aisecmatrix.com/contact.html)

## Free AI security tools
- [Prompt Injection Checker](https://aisecmatrix.com/tools/prompt-injection-checker.html): detects jailbreaks, instruction overrides, hidden Unicode and exfiltration payloads in text, mapped to OWASP LLM Top 10
- [OWASP LLM Top 10 Checklist (2025)](https://aisecmatrix.com/tools/owasp-llm-top-10-checklist.html): 50 interactive controls and tests for LLM apps, RAG and agents

## Other free security tools
- [All free tools](https://aisecmatrix.com/tools.html): password generator, strength and breach checkers, scam message analyzer, QR scanner, security headers scanner, Wi-Fi default password lookup, fake job offer checker, email header analyzer
